import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector, Euler
sc = bpy.context.scene

def mat(name, col, rough=0.5, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs[0].default_value = (*col, 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    m.diffuse_color = (*col, 1)
    return m

M = dict(body=mat("CarBody",(0.02,0.35,0.8),0.3,0.3), accent=mat("CarAccent",(1.0,0.45,0.02),0.4),
         dark=mat("CarDark",(0.02,0.02,0.02),0.6), tyre=mat("Tyre",(0.01,0.01,0.01),0.9),
         glass=mat("Glass",(0.05,0.08,0.1),0.1), asphalt=mat("Asphalt",(0.05,0.05,0.055),0.85),
         grass=mat("Grass",(0.08,0.3,0.06),0.9), curbR=mat("CurbRed",(0.8,0.03,0.03),0.6),
         curbW=mat("CurbWhite",(0.9,0.9,0.9),0.6), line=mat("Line",(0.95,0.95,0.95),0.6))

# ---- centerline: straight, 90° left corner, straight ----
pts=[]; dirs=[]
R=22.0
for i in range(41):  # straight from x=-60 to 0 along +X
    x=-60+60*i/40; pts.append(Vector((x,0,0))); dirs.append(Vector((1,0,0)))
for i in range(1,41):  # arc center (0,R)
    a=-math.pi/2 + (math.pi/2)*i/40
    pts.append(Vector((R*math.cos(a), R+R*math.sin(a),0))); dirs.append(Vector((-math.sin(a),math.cos(a),0)))
for i in range(1,41):
    y=R+60*i/40; pts.append(Vector((R,y,0))); dirs.append(Vector((0,1,0)))
# cumulative length
cum=[0.0]
for i in range(1,len(pts)): cum.append(cum[-1]+(pts[i]-pts[i-1]).length)

def ribbon(name, off_in, off_out, z, material, stripes=None):
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm=bmesh.new()
    vs=[]
    for p,d in zip(pts,dirs):
        n=Vector((-d.y,d.x,0))  # left normal
        vs.append((bm.verts.new(p+n*off_in+Vector((0,0,z))), bm.verts.new(p+n*off_out+Vector((0,0,z)))))
    for i in range(len(vs)-1):
        f=bm.faces.new((vs[i][0],vs[i][1],vs[i+1][1],vs[i+1][0]))
        f.material_index = (i%2) if stripes else 0
    bm.normal_update()
    for f in bm.faces:
        if f.normal.z<0: f.normal_flip()
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o)
    if stripes:
        me.materials.append(stripes[0]); me.materials.append(stripes[1])
    else: me.materials.append(material)
    return o

W=6.0
ribbon("Track",-W,W,0.02,M['asphalt'])
ribbon("Curb_Left",W,W+1.0,0.04,None,(M['curbR'],M['curbW']))
ribbon("Curb_Right",-W-1.0,-W,0.04,None,(M['curbR'],M['curbW']))
ribbon("EdgeLine_L",W-0.5,W-0.3,0.03,M['line'])
ribbon("EdgeLine_R",-W+0.3,-W+0.5,0.03,M['line'])
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1,location=(0,25,0)); g=bpy.context.object; g.name="Grass"; g.scale=(220,220,1); g.data.materials.append(M['grass'])
# start line
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1,location=(-50,0,0.035)); s=bpy.context.object; s.name="StartLine"; s.scale=(1.0,2*W,1); s.data.materials.append(M['line'])
sc['_pts']=[tuple(p) for p in pts]; sc['_dirs']=[tuple(d) for d in dirs]; sc['_cum']=cum
print(len(pts), cum[-1])

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
M=bpy.data.materials
root=bpy.data.objects.new("RaceCar",None); sc.collection.objects.link(root); root.empty_display_size=2

def poly(name, verts, faces, m):
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); me.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); sc.collection.objects.link(o); o.parent=root
    me.materials.append(M[m]); 
    bm=bmesh.new(); bm.from_mesh(me); bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    return o

def loft(name, sections, m):
    # sections: list of (x, half_w_bottom, half_w_top, z_bot, z_top)
    v=[];f=[]
    for x,wb,wt,zb,zt in sections:
        v+= [(x,-wb,zb),(x,wb,zb),(x,wt,zt),(x,-wt,zt)]
    n=len(sections)
    for i in range(n-1):
        a=i*4;b=a+4
        for k in range(4):
            f.append((a+k,a+(k+1)%4,b+(k+1)%4,b+k))
    f.append((3,2,1,0)); f.append((4*(n-1),4*(n-1)+1,4*(n-1)+2,4*(n-1)+3))
    return poly(name,v,f,m)

# main body: wedge nose to squared tail
loft("Body",[(2.25,0.55,0.35,0.18,0.30),(1.6,0.9,0.7,0.15,0.50),(0.6,0.95,0.8,0.15,0.62),
             (-0.6,0.95,0.85,0.15,0.68),(-1.7,0.92,0.8,0.15,0.66),(-2.2,0.85,0.7,0.18,0.60)],"CarBody")
# canopy
loft("Canopy",[(0.9,0.6,0.25,0.6,0.62),(0.3,0.65,0.45,0.66,1.05),(-0.6,0.65,0.45,0.70,1.08),(-1.3,0.6,0.3,0.68,0.75)],"Glass")
# accent stripe on top (thin)
loft("Stripe",[(2.2,0.12,0.12,0.30,0.32),(1.6,0.14,0.14,0.50,0.52),(0.85,0.14,0.14,0.61,0.63)],"CarAccent")
# front splitter
loft("Splitter",[(2.45,0.85,0.85,0.08,0.13),(1.7,1.0,1.0,0.08,0.13)],"CarDark")
# side skirts
for s in (-1,1):
    loft(f"Skirt_{'L' if s>0 else 'R'}",[(1.2,0.06,0.06,0.10,0.25),(-1.3,0.06,0.06,0.10,0.25)],"CarAccent").location.y=s*0.95
# rear wing: posts + plane + endplates
for s in (-1,1):
    loft("WingPost",[(-1.85,0.04,0.04,0.6,1.15),(-2.0,0.04,0.04,0.6,1.15)],"CarDark").location.y=s*0.45
loft("Wing",[(-1.75,0.95,0.95,1.12,1.16),(-2.3,0.95,0.95,1.18,1.24)],"CarAccent")
for s in (-1,1):
    loft("Endplate",[(-1.7,0.02,0.02,0.95,1.35),(-2.35,0.02,0.02,0.95,1.35)],"CarDark").location.y=s*0.97
# diffuser
loft("Diffuser",[(-1.9,0.8,0.8,0.10,0.2),(-2.35,0.8,0.8,0.18,0.35)],"CarDark")
# headlights / taillights
mats_extra={}
hl=bpy.data.materials.new("HeadLight"); hl.use_nodes=True
b=next(n for n in hl.node_tree.nodes if n.type=="BSDF_PRINCIPLED"); b.inputs[0].default_value=(1,1,0.9,1)
b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value=3; 
try: b.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value=(1,1,0.85,1)
except KeyError: b.inputs["Emission"].default_value=(1,1,0.85,1)
tl=bpy.data.materials.new("TailLight"); tl.use_nodes=True
b=next(n for n in tl.node_tree.nodes if n.type=="BSDF_PRINCIPLED"); b.inputs[0].default_value=(1,0,0,1)
b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value=4
try: b.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value=(1,0.02,0.02,1)
except KeyError: b.inputs["Emission"].default_value=(1,0.02,0.02,1)
for s in (-1,1):
    o=loft("HeadLight",[(2.0,0.18,0.15,0.33,0.38),(1.75,0.18,0.15,0.40,0.47)],"HeadLight"); o.location.y=s*0.6
    o=loft("TailLight",[(-2.18,0.22,0.22,0.48,0.56),(-2.22,0.22,0.22,0.48,0.56)],"TailLight"); o.location.y=s*0.55
# wheels
wheels=[]
for x in (1.45,-1.4):
    for s in (-1,1):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=10,radius=0.36,depth=0.32,location=(x,s*0.92,0.36),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
        w=bpy.context.object; w.name="Wheel"; w.data.materials.append(M["Tyre"])
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6,radius=0.2,depth=0.34,location=(x,s*0.92,0.36),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
        h=bpy.context.object; h.name="Hub"; h.data.materials.append(M["CarAccent"])
        h.parent=w; h.matrix_parent_inverse=w.matrix_world.inverted()
        w.parent=root; wheels.append(w)
for o in root.children:
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=False
print("ok")

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
pts=[Vector(p) for p in sc['_pts']]; dirs=[Vector(d) for d in sc['_dirs']]; cum=list(sc['_cum'])
def sample(s):
    s=max(0,min(cum[-1],s))
    for i in range(1,len(cum)):
        if cum[i]>=s: break
    t=(s-cum[i-1])/(cum[i]-cum[i-1])
    p=pts[i-1].lerp(pts[i],t); d=dirs[i-1].lerp(dirs[i],t).normalized()
    return p,d
car=bpy.data.objects["RaceCar"]
sc.frame_start=1; sc.frame_end=120; sc.render.fps=24
s0,s1=12.0,148.0
yaw_prev=None
wheels=[o for o in car.children if o.name.startswith("Wheel")]
for f in range(1,121):
    t=(f-1)/119
    s=s0+(s1-s0)*t
    p,d=sample(s)
    yaw=math.atan2(d.y,d.x)
    car.location=p; car.rotation_euler=(0,0,yaw)
    car.keyframe_insert("location",frame=f); car.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler",frame=f)
    for w in wheels:
        w.rotation_euler=(math.pi/2, (s-s0)/0.36, 0)
        w.keyframe_insert("rotation_euler",index=1,frame=f)
# camera
cam=bpy.data.objects.get("Camera")
cam.animation_data_clear(); cam.constraints.clear(); cam.parent=None
tgt=bpy.data.objects.new("ChaseTarget",None); sc.collection.objects.link(tgt)
tgt.parent=car; tgt.location=(3.0,0,0.6)
for f in range(1,121):
    t=(f-1)/119; s=s0+(s1-s0)*t
    p,d=sample(s-8.0)
    cam.location=p+Vector((0,0,2.8)); cam.keyframe_insert("location",frame=f)
c=cam.constraints.new('TRACK_TO'); c.target=tgt; c.track_axis='TRACK_NEGATIVE_Z'; c.up_axis='UP_Y'
cam.data.lens=32; cam.name="ChaseCam"
sc.camera=cam
for o in [car,cam]+wheels:
    if o.animation_data and o.animation_data.action:
        try:
            fcs=o.animation_data.action.fcurves
        except AttributeError:
            fcs=[fc for l in o.animation_data.action.layers for st in l.strips for cb in st.channelbags for fc in cb.fcurves]
        for fc in fcs:
            for k in fc.keyframe_points: k.interpolation='LINEAR'
cur=sc.render.engine
try: sc.render.engine='BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
except TypeError:
    try: sc.render.engine='BLENDER_EEVEE'
    except TypeError as e: print(e)
sc.render.resolution_x=1280; sc.render.resolution_y=720; sc.render.resolution_percentage=100
sc.frame_set(1)
print(cur, sc.render.engine)
